name: ntl
title: Night-time lights per capita
description: Annual night-time lights per capita for Bolivia's 339 municipalities, 2012–2020, in natural logs: the total VIIRS Day/Night Band radiance of each municipality divided by its population. A Hodrick–Prescott trend (λ = 400) of the same series isolates its long-run path. Night-time lights are a widely used proxy for local economic activity and electrification.

sources.title: Elvidge, C. D., Zhizhin, M., Ghosh, T., Hsu, F.-C., & Taneja, J. (2021). Annual time series of global VIIRS nighttime lights derived from monthly averages: 2012 to 2019. Remote Sensing, 13(5), 922.
WorldPop (2018). Global High Resolution Population Denominators Project (100 m, 2000–2020). University of Southampton.
Mendez, C. (2026). DS4Bolivia: A Data Science Repository to Study Regional Development in Bolivia [Data set]. GitHub.

geo:citation: GeoDevelopment Observatory of Bolivia (2026). Night-time lights per capita (339 municipalities, 2012–2020). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/geo4bolivia/blob/main/docs/datasets/ntl.md
geo:notes: Both variables are logs of a ratio, so they cannot be summed or averaged up the hierarchy; their aggregation rule is `none`. Aggregate the levels instead, e.g. NTL = exp(ln_NTLpc) × pop, summed with `pop` from the population dataset.
Computed by DS4Bolivia on its own municipal polygons (`asdf_id`), which differ slightly from the GADM boundaries used for geo IDs.
Population is the gridded estimate of the `pop` dataset.
